cases.rationale: Two actual people in black wetsuits are lying on identifiable surfboards in breaking water. The board rails and decks are visible; these are not boats, snowboards or skateboards. The dark shapes are the surfers' clothed bodies, not animals. I considered all 75 frozen definitions against the whole crop; no other category object is visible and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The catcher, umpire, cropped runner and background players are actual people. The catcher extends an identifiable brown fielding mitt to the left, supporting baseball glove. The tiny upright pale item at the far right edge of the green ground mat lacks sufficient neck/rim detail to distinguish a bottle from a drinking cup, so bottle and cup remain unclear. The backstop, field, bats and helmets do not establish additional listed categories; no identifiable bench seat is exposed. I explicitly considered every frozen definition.

The central yellow face has clock hands and time numerals, clearly identifying an actual clock. The surrounding tall colored spine-like blocks and thin stacked items resemble books, but the clock construction could use decorative imitation book blocks, and actual binding/pages cannot be determined confidently at this resolution; book remains unclear. The supporting shelf is not an identifiable dining table. I considered all 75 definitions and found no other category object.

An actual black dog with a recognizable head, legs and tail stands in a pickup truck bed; the bed walls, wheel wells and cab identify truck rather than passenger car. The red-and-white box at the left is a portable cooler, not an identifiable refrigerator, suitcase or other listed container. I considered each of the 75 frozen definitions; no further listed object or unresolved category ambiguity is visible.

A person is crouched in the air above a recognizable skateboard with a small wheeled deck. The wheels distinguish it from a snowboard or surfboard. The large pole has no identifiable traffic-signal head, and the tree/shrub has no visible pot. The concrete ledge does not show an intended bench seat. I explicitly considered all 75 definitions; no additional category object or unresolved ambiguity is present.

An actual multi-car rail vehicle travels on visible rails beneath overhead wires, establishing train. The two suspended red-arrow traffic signal heads establish traffic light. The tiny dark shape at the top of the central distant upright could be a perched bird or an attached fitting; inadequate body detail leaves bird unclear. Barricades and signs are not stop signs. I considered all 75 definitions, with no other listed object identified.

The large octagonal ALTO sign is an actual stop sign. Passenger vehicles are recognizable along the right street edge, and pink single-person chair structures are visible at the lower left. Several plants grow from visible containers beside the building, establishing potted plant rather than greenery alone. A more distant pale utility vehicle partly hidden by the tree may be a truck, but its body style is unresolved. The cropped pink seating at the extreme lower left also leaves a possible longer bench component unresolved. Truck and bench remain unclear. I considered every one of the 75 definitions.

An actual red locomotive and intermodal rail equipment occupy the raised track, identifying train rather than road truck. The foreground blue canopy has radiating umbrella panels and a curved umbrella perimeter, supporting umbrella. The CN lettering and painted graphics do not count as actual depicted objects. I examined the whole crop against all 75 definitions; no other identifiable category object or unresolved category ambiguity is visible.

An actual cat has its face inside a tall white drinking cup. The vessel is a cup form rather than a bowl, bottle or stemmed wine glass. A wooden dining chair back is visible behind the eating table, which has bread and the cup on it. The papers at the left are loose printed/news pages rather than an identifiable bound book; the bagged bread does not show sandwich filling or a definite cake/donut identity. I considered all 75 definitions and have no unresolved category ambiguity.

The baseball player is an actual person holding a clearly identifiable black fielding glove in front of the torso. The fence lettering and scoreboard do not establish a standalone television or clock; the scoreboard shows game information. I considered all 75 frozen definitions against the entire crop and found no additional listed object or unresolved ambiguity.

An actual adult is visible behind the small steam-locomotive-shaped vehicle. Its size relative to the adult and its park setting leave uncertainty between a small actual operating rail train and a miniature/ride model, which the frozen train definition excludes; train therefore remains unclear. The surrounding flowers and trees lack identifiable plant pots, and the canopy is a fixed shelter rather than an umbrella. I considered every one of the 75 definitions and found no other listed object.

A large actual elephant is identifiable by its head, ear, skin and curved trunk. Human arms/body parts at the upper left and in the background identify actual people. The red parasol canopy in the upper background identifies an umbrella. The bird-like painted forms on the canvas are excluded depictions, and the elephant's painting brush is not a toothbrush. I considered all 75 definitions; no additional listed object or unresolved category ambiguity is present.
